mapping_notes.Battery: Battery, starter, alternator, and charging diagnoses belong to the shared electrical-system class.
mapping_notes.Brakes: Descriptions and diagnoses concern brake pedals, pads, rotors, fluid, and master cylinders.
mapping_notes.Electrical: Descriptions and diagnoses concern wiring, lighting, windows, starting, batteries, and alternators.
mapping_notes.Engine: The source uses one broad engine classification for engine symptoms and diagnoses; it is retained as engine_system_fault rather than forcing individual rows into narrower classes.
mapping_notes.Transmission: Descriptions and diagnoses concern shifting, gears, clutches, solenoids, and transmission fluid.
